serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `ruff` executable. Leave empty to use the copy the editor installed, or the one on PATH.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Show a notification when the language server cannot be found, offering to install it. Turned off by the notification’s Never Ask Again button.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of Ruff the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file, which is how you choose between Ruff and another Python server. Only what Ruff implements is listed: it is a linter and a formatter, so it has no completions, navigation or symbols.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report Ruff's violations in the linter. Turning this off also stops the server computing them.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Explain the rule behind a noqa code on hover.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer Ruff's fixes in the intentions list.

configuration.title: Configuration File
configuration.description: Path to a `ruff.toml` or `pyproject.toml` file to use instead of the one discovered next to the source. Leave empty for the usual discovery.

configurationPreference.title: Configuration Preference
configurationPreference.description: Which wins when these settings and a discovered `ruff.toml` or `pyproject.toml` disagree.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: File patterns Ruff never looks at, on top of the ones its configuration file excludes.

lineLength.title: Line Length
lineLength.description: Line length used by the linter and the formatter. Leave at 0 to use the value from the Ruff configuration file.

fixAll.title: Fix All
fixAll.description: Offer a fix-all code action that resolves every fixable violation in the document.

organizeImports.title: Organize Imports
organizeImports.description: Offer an organize-imports code action driven by Ruff's isort rules.

showSyntaxErrors.title: Show Syntax Errors
showSyntaxErrors.description: Report Python syntax errors found while parsing as diagnostics.

useNoqa.title: Use noqa Flag
useNoqa.description: Honor `# noqa` and file-level noqa comments when reporting diagnostics.

logLevel.title: Log Level
logLevel.description: How much Ruff writes to its log, which `ide-client:show-log` opens.

lint.title: Lint
lint.description: Which rules run. Leave the lists empty to use the Ruff configuration files.

preview.title: Preview Rules
preview.description: Enable rules and behaviour Ruff still marks as unstable.

select.title: Select
select.description: Rule codes to enable, replacing the configured set, or `ALL` for every rule.

extendSelect.title: Extend Select
extendSelect.description: Rule codes to enable on top of the configured set, rather than in place of it.

fixable.title: Fixable
fixable.description: Rule codes to treat as eligible for autofix.

unfixable.title: Unfixable
unfixable.description: Rule codes to treat as ineligible for autofix.

preview.title: Preview Style
preview.description: Format with the style changes Ruff still marks as unstable.

codeAction.title: Code Actions
codeAction.description: Which fixes Ruff offers in the intentions list.

disableRuleComment.title: Disable Rule Comment
disableRuleComment.description: Offer a code action that appends a `# noqa` comment silencing the violation.

fixViolation.title: Fix Violation
fixViolation.description: Offer a code action that applies the autofix of a single violation.
